title: ArchitectureConstraintCompliance
description: TOGAF-sourced norm archetype — the measurable compliance facet of a TOGAF Constraint. While the Constraint directive (directives/Constraint) captures the design limitation intent, this schema captures the measurable assertion for verifying constraint adherence. Requires GSM unsealing of Norm to be functional. Extends Norm with TOGAF constraint compliance measurement vocabulary. TOGAF mapping: Constraint compliance assessment (ADM Requirements Management). Source framework: TOGAF (ADM, Requirements Management).

constraintSource.description: Origin of the constraint (mirrors the Constraint directive). TOGAF mapping: Constraint source classification.

enforcementMode.description: How constraint compliance is enforced. PREVENTIVE = blocks non-compliant actions. DETECTIVE = identifies violations after-the-fact. CORRECTIVE = automatically remediates violations. TOGAF mapping: Constraint enforcement approach.
